name: Sermon
anchors: Blessed are those who show mercy
for they shall receive mercy in
return Compassion is not weakness but
the greatest strength we can possess
When we choose love over judgment
we transform not only ourselves but
those around us as well The
path to enlightenment begins with understanding
Let us walk this path together
